text: PEPTIDE LANE 3 (PAYMENT GENERALIZATION) SHIPPED. Exact SHA 510bc4ba4ff616b37b01bce8e69042c4be4c69a3 on lane/peptide-payment-generalization-20260821, cut from pushed head c371201. NEW FILES ONLY: server/research/early-access/release/canonical-payment-eligibility{,.test}.ts. No existing file touched. 22 tests + release suite 223/223, tsc clean, no production mutation. WHAT IT IS: the containment for the 8-step payment journey. Today the cart and release routes run scope 'released_units' (cart/adapters.ts:73, release-routes.ts:161) so only the founder-released opening set (22 visible / 18 purchasable) can take money. Generalizing to the canonical peptide set REMOVES that containment, so the rules the release ledger was silently enforcing have to be written down. canonicalPaymentEligibility(facts, policy) refuses on FAMILY_NOT_DIRECT / AVAILABILITY_UNDER_REVIEW / UNIT_HELD / CLASSIFICATION_NOT_CONFIRMED / COMPOSITION_UNRESOLVED / NO_APPROVED_PRICE in that order, so price is consulted LAST and can never promote a row. THE SEQUENCING FINDING, please read before the reconciliation lane generates variants: six workbook peptide rows have no runtime variant - GRP-0421 RETATRUTIDE 60mg 249 (generate), GRP-0422 CJC-1295 WITH DAC + IPAMORELIN split-pending 99 (BLOCK), GRP-0423 MOTS-C 40mg 129 (generate), GRP-0424 GLUTATHIONE 600mg 69 (generate), GRP-0425 OXYTOCIN 10mg 59 (DUPLICATE - do not generate), GRP-0426 HEXARELIN 5mg 49 (DUPLICATE - do not generate). 135 runtime + 4 generatable = the founder's 139 exactly; 29 pending minus the 2 duplicates = 27 unique pending exactly; 112 RUO minus GRP-0422 = 111 direct exactly. Every founder number reconciles. GRP-0422 satisfies EVERY condition s3's pathway resolver checks - right family, RUO channel, priced - and the ONLY thing stopping a sale today is that the variant does not exist. The day lane 1 generates it, this gate is the sole thing between the customer and a combination whose split we cannot state. That is why I shipped the block before the generation rather than after. INTEGRATION: pass DIRECT_PURCHASE_FAMILIES as policy.directPurchaseFamilies from customer-pathway.ts once you push it - I did NOT import it because it is not committed on any pushed commit, only dirty in your worktree, so importing would make this unbuildable for every other lane. There is no default: a caller must reach for the canonical list. Also still open from me, unclaimed: the member-commerce WRITE wall (my earlier message) - the PATCH/DELETE trap at index.ts:682 means the obvious fix will look done while leaving quantity-change and remove-line walled.
